title: Clan Battleship Bingo
rules:
Each team hides its fleet on its own copy of the board. When a player gets one of these drops in game, post the screenshot in Discord and your team fires at that square in the other team's waters.
A red cross is a hit, a ring is a miss. Sink every enemy ship to win.

cells.name: Twisted bow
cells.hover: Any Chambers of Xeric purple counts for this square.
